races.paceDynamic: Gone Rogue and Miss Chester will both break quickly from the gates and establish the early tempo as the only confirmed front-runners in this field. Their natural speed means they'll create an honest gallop from the outset, with Toralou, Riyadh Gem, and Pearly Squirrel likely to track them in the second rank. The sustained pace should create a strong finish, but without excessive early fractions that would completely drain the leaders. This pace dynamic clearly favours prominent racers who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the early speed duel.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Maintain Control
scenarios.trigger: If Gone Rogue and Miss Chester share the workload without killing each other's chances
scenarios.body: The honest but not suicidal gallop allows one leader to kick clear in the final furlong while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground. Gone Rogue's recent good form and lower weight give him the edge over Miss Chester's longer absence.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Strike Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong as both leaders commit fully
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop sets up perfectly for horses positioned in second rank to sweep past tired leaders in final 100 yards. Toralou and Pearly Squirrel are ideally placed to exploit this scenario with their tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely searching and leaders tie up significantly
scenarios.body: The strong gallop creates maximum opportunity for closers to unleash their finishing kick from the back. Time After Time's dual wins this distance on good ground make him the standout closer if this unfolds.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Messy Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders go too slowly early and create a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns this into a pure speed test in the final three furlongs. This completely changes the complexion and allows any horse with a sharp turn of foot to win.

races.paceDynamic: Oursin, High Degree, Alcarath, Clouds Hill and Al Durry will ensure a strong gallop from the start in this 1m2f handicap. With five confirmed front-runners all likely to dispute the early lead, the pace will be genuinely strong throughout, creating a searching test of stamina. The leaders will soften each other up in the opening exchanges before the field spreads out entering the home straight. This aggressive early pace strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble and deliver late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Hold-Up
scenarios.trigger: If the five front-runners engage in early pace battles as expected
scenarios.body: The leaders will compromise each other through honest fractions, setting up the race perfectly for closers with stamina. Parole d'Oro, Celeborn, Mustazeed and Al Aali can all benefit from this pace collapse scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners can steal a march and dictate terms
scenarios.body: Either Clouds Hill or Al Durry could pinch a break if the other pace angles neutralise each other early. The winner would need to have enough left to repel late challenges from the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Profits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with the leaders going too fast then too slow
scenarios.body: Hand Of God and Something Splendid sitting in prominent positions could time their runs perfectly. They would avoid the early pace battle but stay close enough to strike when the leaders falter.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace burns out completely and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with horses finishing in reverse order of early positioning. Any horse with a turn of foot regardless of running style could capitalise on the chaos.

races.paceDynamic: Sponsor and Oceti will contest the early lead in this 16-runner novice field, with both horses showing confirmed front-running tendencies from their recent form. The large field size means the pace won't be overly demanding early, but the presence of two natural leaders should ensure an honest gallop throughout the 7f trip. With most of the field comprised of hold-up performers and several making debuts, the race will likely develop into a sustained drive from the 3f pole. This race shape clearly favours horses with tactical speed who can position prominently rather than those relying on late finishing kicks from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners collapse late
scenarios.trigger: If Sponsor and Oceti duel too hard early and weaken in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The honest pace will set up perfectly for the prominent racers who can avoid the early battle but stay within striking distance. Erudition and the Varian newcomers become major players as the leaders fade.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace setter proves best
scenarios.trigger: If either Sponsor or Oceti gets an uncontested lead while the other settles
scenarios.body: The winner will dictate terms from the front and prove too strong for the closers in a race lacking natural pace pressers. Strong pace judgement from Dobbs or Leavy becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Debutant surprise package
scenarios.trigger: If one of the Balding/Varian newcomers shows sharp early pace to track the leaders
scenarios.body: The newcomer settles perfectly in behind the front pair before producing a telling surge when the leaders weaken. Class tells in a race where experience counts for less.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold up horse strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is slower than expected and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: Extremely Zain gets the perfect setup to unleash his finishing kick despite the tactical disadvantage. Fallon times his challenge to perfection as others struggle for racing room.

races.paceDynamic: Blue Hercules provides the only confirmed early pace in this maiden, likely to get an uncontested lead with the prominent runners Point Of Law, Hatteen and Siwa Oasis settling just behind rather than challenging. The moderate early gallop will suit the hold-up horses Glory Road, Much and El Loco who can track the field before making late moves. However, Blue Hercules has shown a tendency to fade in the finish, creating opportunity for the prominent runners to strike in the straight. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can position handy, avoid traffic problems, and have the tactical speed to capitalise when the pacemaker weakens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Hercules sets sustainable fractions but fades as expected in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Point Of Law and Hatteen can position ideally behind the pacemaker and strike when he weakens, avoiding the traffic that will trap hold-up horses. Their prominent style perfectly suits picking up the pieces from a weakening leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes even more sedate than expected with Blue Hercules going very slowly
scenarios.body: Glory Road and El Loco get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks from the rear, with the field coming back to them in a sprint finish. The patient tactics pay dividends when others have gone too early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Blue Hercules Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Hercules finds improvement and doesn't fade as badly as his previous run suggests
scenarios.body: The pacemaker could maintain his advantage to the line if the closing horses leave their runs too late on the testing ground. His front-running style becomes an asset rather than a liability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the inexperienced field creates a messy, stop-start pace with multiple horses vying for position
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair where positioning and jockey skill matter most, potentially favouring the more experienced runners. Traffic problems could eliminate several chances.

races.paceDynamic: Heyzoom stands as the sole confirmed front runner in this 11-runner maiden, likely to set an uncontested lead with the prominent runners Besieged, Echo Of Stars and North Beach settling just behind. The pace will be sustainable rather than frantic given the lack of early speed, with the hold-up trio of Electric Dreams, Salgados and Tambora relying on the race developing into a sprint finish. Five debutants including Tropbien and Knight Of Storms add unknowns to the equation, but the likely scenario is a steady gallop building to a finish where those able to pick up strongly from mid-pack or closer will have the advantage over pure hold-up horses who may find insufficient pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Heyzoom sets steady fractions with the prominent group tracking closely
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of who can quicken best from a handy position, suiting those with tactical speed over pure closers. Echo Of Stars and Besieged are perfectly positioned to strike from just behind the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Debut Star Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the Gosden/Simcock newcomers shows significant ability on debut
scenarios.body: Tropbien or Knight Of Storms could possess the class edge over these exposed maidens, with their connections' strike rates offering hope. The newcomer settles prominently and outstays the field in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If Heyzoom gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The Owen Burrows runner proves too strong when allowed to dictate throughout, building an unassailable advantage. His recent second over course and distance suggests the ability to take full advantage of these tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely allowing the back markers to close strongly
scenarios.body: Electric Dreams, Salgados or Tambora get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks that overwhelm the leaders. This requires the front group to go too slowly early and crack under pressure late.

races.paceDynamic: Three Socks On will lead from the gates with no natural pace challengers, setting a modest tempo through the early stages. The prominent group of Extraterrestrial, Armstrong, Glenna, Brighton View, Tough Date, Rossa Raheen, La Peregrina and Kalokalo will sit in a comfortable pack behind the lone leader. With Three Socks On having a known tendency to fade and no genuine pace pressure, the tempo will be steady but not searching early, setting up a tactical finish from the 3f pole. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish powerfully from off the pace, as they'll get the perfect setup of an uncontested leader who weakens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Setup
scenarios.trigger: If Three Socks On maintains a steady gallop without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The tempo stays comfortable throughout allowing closers perfect conditions to unleash late runs. Hold-up horses get the ideal scenario with plenty left in the tank for the final 2f surge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Builds
scenarios.trigger: If Armstrong and Extraterrestrial move up to challenge Three Socks On from halfway
scenarios.body: The pace quickens materially in the middle stages, stretching the field and creating gaps for tactical runners. Those who can quicken from handy positions benefit most from the increased tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Collapse and Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Three Socks On stops abruptly turning for home leaving a dawdling pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a mad dash from the 2f pole with positioning crucial in the sprint. Horses with natural speed who can respond quickly from their berths will dominate.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Injection Fails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get poor runs or the pace stays too slow throughout
scenarios.body: Tactical runners and prominent racers prove superior when the tempo doesn't collapse completely. Those who can sustain their effort rather than relying on one gear change prevail.

races.paceDynamic: Curran is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the gate in this 16-runner handicap, likely setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure. The prominent runners Percy Jones, Amancio and Perfect Scoundrel may track him but none are aggressive pace-pressers, allowing Curran to control the tempo. This will create a tactical affair where the large hold-up contingent including Educator, Yokohama, Kimeko Glory and Rose Cotton will be queuing up for racing room in the straight. The controlled pace and likely bunched finish strongly favours prominent racers who can secure good positions early and avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably affect the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Favours Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Curran sets uncontested fractions and the prominent horses get first run
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows those just off the lead to position perfectly and strike first when the race begins in earnest. Hold-up horses get caught in traffic behind a wall of runners.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horses Find Gaps
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens mid-race and gaps appear for the closers
scenarios.body: The strong contingent of hold-up horses get the racing room they need and their superior finishing kicks prove decisive. Jockeys like De Sousa and Mitchell excel in these scenarios.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Curran's early advantage proves insurmountable and no serious challenge materializes
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds an unassailable advantage and holds on despite the weight of numbers behind. The lack of early pace pressure works entirely in the leader's favour.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Into Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early tempo is exceptionally slow and it becomes a dash from the back
scenarios.body: The race turns into a pure sprint finish where tactical position matters less than raw speed. The most unexposed runner or best recent form horse capitalizes.

watchPoints.text: Curran must be monitored closely early as the uncontested leader could build an unassailable advantage if not challenged
Traffic problems are inevitable in the straight with 12+ hold-up horses converging simultaneously
Percy Jones and Amancio as the main prominent runners are perfectly positioned if the pace stays controlled
Yokohama with De Sousa represents the best hope for the hold-up brigade if gaps materialise
Possible returning from 337 days off for an in-form trainer could surprise at big odds if needing the run
